about_the_game:
Customize Your Lucky Cards

In Lucky Card, you can freely combine the winning rules of scratch cards and the prizes that may be revealed. Fit more scratch cards into the rule cards with limited space, turning every scratch into a unique adventure full of strategic variables and surprising feedback!

Break the Boundaries of Reality

The prizes of scratch cards are endowed with diverse synergy rules. When combined with different rule cards, buffs, panel light effects, color strips, and boss strategies, they open up new paths for your journey to win big with scratch cards.

  • 4 types of winning rule cards, each with a different winning multiplier

  • Over 200 types of scratch card winning elements, allowing you to create various synergies

  • 5 light effects and 5 color strip variant scratch cards, which can enhance the basic attributes of scratch cards

  • 20 types of buffs, further increasing the reward values

  • 20 types of boss strategies, helping you take a bold gamble at critical moments

Thank You for Testing

The demo version currently only has one difficulty level, and various contents are still in production.
Finally, we hope to receive more feedback to help improve the game.

name: Lucky Card Demo
short_description: Lucky Card takes scratch cards as its prototype and integrates roguelite, strategic deck-building, and inventory management gameplay. It creates a unique immersive experience that real-world scratch cards can never replicate.
